title: Add Daily_Production_Report table with operation-wise tracking

requirements.text: Create a Daily_Production_Report data structure in the backend with fields: id (Primary Key), date (Date), operation_name (Text), today_production (Number), total_completed (Number), despatched (Number), in_hand (Number)

quotes: Fields required: id (Primary Key), date (Date), operation_name (Text), today_production (Number), total_completed (Number), despatched (Number), in_hand (Number)

acceptanceCriteria: Backend data structure includes all seven fields with correct types
id field serves as unique identifier
date field stores daily production date
operation_name field stores text identifiers for operations
today_production, total_completed, despatched, and in_hand fields store numeric values

requirements.text: Populate the Daily_Production_Report with default operation name entries: Boxing, Welding/Finishing, Rear Wall, Front Wall, Side Wall, Roof, Rear Door, Blasting & Primer, Final Paint, Gasket, DLM, Plywood, Floor Screw, Decal, Data Plate, Sikha, Black Paint

quotes: Insert the following operation names as default rows: Boxing, Welding/Finishing, Rear Wall, Front Wall, Side Wall, Roof, Rear Door, Blasting & Primer, Final Paint, Gasket, DLM, Plywood, Floor Screw, Decal, Data Plate, Sikha, Black Paint

acceptanceCriteria: All 17 operation names are inserted as default entries
Operation names match exactly as specified including capitalization and special characters
Default entries are available immediately after system initialization

requirements.text: Create backend CRUD operations for Daily_Production_Report that allow administrators to add, retrieve, update, and delete production report records
acceptanceCriteria: Add function creates new production report records with all required fields
Retrieve function returns production reports filtered by date, operation_name, or all records
Update function modifies existing production report records by id
Delete function removes production report records by id
All operations require admin authentication

requirements.text: Build a frontend page for Daily Production Report management that displays a form to enter/edit daily production data for each operation with fields for date, operation_name selection, today_production, total_completed, despatched, and in_hand
acceptanceCriteria: Form includes date picker for selecting production date
Operation name dropdown populated with all 17 default operations
Numeric input fields for today_production, total_completed, despatched, and in_hand
Form validates all required fields before submission
Success and error messages display after form submission
Form follows existing industrial dashboard visual theme

requirements.text: Create a frontend table view that displays all Daily_Production_Report records in a sortable, filterable table showing all fields (date, operation_name, today_production, total_completed, despatched, in_hand) with edit and delete actions
acceptanceCriteria: Table displays all Daily_Production_Report records with all seven fields
Table supports sorting by date, operation_name, and numeric fields
Filter allows searching by date range and operation name
Edit action opens form pre-populated with selected record data
Delete action removes record after confirmation
Table follows existing industrial table styling with consistent typography and layout

requirements.text: Add navigation menu item linking to the Daily Production Report page in the main application navigation
acceptanceCriteria: New menu item labeled 'Daily Production Report' appears in main navigation
Menu item appears in both desktop and mobile navigation
Clicking the menu item navigates to the Daily Production Report page
Menu item styling matches existing navigation items

constraints: All Daily_Production_Report operations must require admin authentication
Use single-actor backend architecture in backend/main.mo
Follow existing industrial dashboard visual theme with neutral color palette
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui
nonGoals: Automated production calculations beyond in_hand = total_completed - despatched
